name: browser-tabs
title: Browser Tabs
description: Every open tab of your browsers with its favicon. Enter switches to it; close, mute and copy from the action panel.
author: pal

settings.label: DevTools port
settings.description: The --remote-debugging-port of a Chromium browser (Chrome, Brave, Edge, Chromium). When something listens there its tabs come over the DevTools protocol, with playing and muted state; otherwise the browsers below are asked.

settings.label: Scriptable browsers
settings.description: macOS only: browsers asked over AppleScript when they are running, by app name. A Chromium browser already on the DevTools port is skipped.

settings.label: Firefox
settings.text: List Firefox tabs from its session file
settings.description: Read-only: Firefox has no scripting interface, so Focus only raises its window.

settings.label: Firefox session file
settings.description: A sessionstore-backups/recovery.jsonlz4; empty finds the most recent profile's.

tabs.description: Open tabs across Chrome, Safari and Firefox.
